sharedRules.name: Waaagh!
sharedRules.description:
You can re-roll the Advance roll.
While this unit is riled up, this unit has a 5+ invulnerable save.
While this unit is riled up, ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit gain [ASSAULT].
When this unit is selected to make an Advance move, while this unit is riled up, the triggering unit is eligible to declare a charge even if it Advanced this turn.
At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability, once per battle per army, until the end of the next turn, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh ability are riled up.

sharedRules.name: Special Move Types
sharedRules.description:
Pulse Jet move:
  - The unit can move up to D6+18".
  - While it moves, this unit can move over terrain features and models as though they were not there; this unit ignores vertical distances when it moves; this unit cannot end a move within Engagement Range of any enemy unit.
  - After it moves, until the end of the turn, this unit cannot declare a charge; until the end of the turn, this unit cannot start an Action; until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the attacking unit's Hit rolls.
Assault Disembark move (the Assault mode of a Disembark move):
  - Each model is set up wholly within 3" of that Transport.
  - A unit can make this move only if this unit is embarked and the Transport this unit is embarked within is on the battlefield and this unit did not embark this phase and not (the Transport this unit is embarked within advanced this phase or the Transport this unit is embarked within fell back this phase).

When a friendly WARBOSS model in this unit is destroyed:
